registered_title: Nano-Mamba U-Net: A Spatio-Temporal Framework for Cardiac Motion Analysis

scientific_scope.executed_task: Four-class 3D cardiac MRI segmentation of independently processed ED and ES volumes
scientific_scope.serialized_sequence: B x 2048 x 128; 2048 = 32 x 32 x 2 spatial tokens
scientific_scope.output_tensor: B x 4 x 256 x 256 x 16 followed by argmax over the class axis
scientific_scope.temporal_boundary: The depth axis is anatomical slice depth. ED and ES are not jointly modelled; no tracking, registration, displacement, optical flow, temporal consistency, ejection fraction, or true 4D motion output was evaluated.
scientific_scope.mamba_boundary: The bottleneck is a Mamba-inspired gated spatial sequence module, not a full selective-scan Mamba implementation.
scientific_scope.supported_claim: Nano-Mamba provides a compact accuracy-efficiency trade-off. It is not the highest-Dice model and the executed ablations do not establish a causal gate advantage.

executed_order: LoadImaged loads paired NIfTI image and integer label volumes
EnsureChannelFirstd maps H x W x D to 1 x H x W x D
Resized maps image and label to 256 x 256 x 16
ScaleIntensityd performs per-volume linear 0-1 MRI intensity scaling
ToTensord converts both arrays to tensors
image_processing.evaluation_grid: All reported Dice values are measured on the resized 256 x 256 x 16 grid.

experiment_design.loss: DiceCELoss(to_onehot_y=true, softmax=true); default training loss includes background
experiment_design.reported_metric: Case-level Dice for RV, MYO, and LV, followed by model-level means over the 40 validation cases
training_confounders: batch size differs across model families (1 or 2)
optimizer-step counts per epoch differ with batch size
No-Mamba is not parameter matched to Nano-Mamba

checks: patient split is disjoint and covers the reported 200 cases
every aggregate Dice value is reproduced from case rows
all best epochs are reproduced from 150-epoch curves
checkpoint metadata agrees with model names and reported epochs
non-finite and out-of-range values are rejected
source-lineage comparison is CRLF-neutral but rejects content changes
evidence_consistency.archival_history_note: Optional historical command/environment identity is not a P2 submission requirement and is excluded from the scientific readiness decision.

main_results.curve_interpretation: All six training losses decline while final validation Dice is below the selected maximum; the largest decline is Attention U-Net at 3.05 percentage points, consistent with late-epoch overfitting or instability in that run.
main_results.shared_difficult_case: patient049_frame11 is the lowest-mean case for Nano-Mamba, UNet3D, SegResNet16, No-Mamba, and Half-Mamba; Nano-Mamba mean Dice is 57.86% with RV 26.04%, MYO 64.87%, and LV 82.66%.

open_scientific_limits: validation patients select checkpoints and supply the final table; there is no independent test cohort
only one patient split and one seed are reported
no augmentation or native-space evaluation was performed
ablations are not capacity or optimization matched
ED versus ES and pathology subgroups were not analysed
HD95, ASD, calibration, and formal blinded qualitative review were not evaluated
the architecture does not implement temporal motion modelling

acceptance_checks: final LaTeX pass has no undefined citations or references
final LaTeX pass has no overfull boxes
all 73 pages rendered and visually reviewed

final_audit.disposition: Scientifically and defensively ready for P2 submission with all open design limitations stated. Stronger generalization, causal, native-space, or temporal claims require new experiments.
